vcu_g_0159_20001b32.name: vehicle_event_flags_b
vcu_g_0159_20001b32.description: Packed event-flag word. vcu_latch_event_flags_b sets bits 0 to 2 once (one-shot), and bit 4 is tested by app_apply_mode_limits and vcu_drive_command_update. Probably a 16-bit word.

vcu_g_0159_20001b38.name: vehicle_mode_level
vcu_g_0159_20001b38.description: Mode level 0 to 3, set to 3 by app_apply_mode_limits. It is compared with the speed value divided by 10 by vcu_standby_entry_timer and vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval, so it is probably a speed-class index.

vcu_g_0159_20001b3a.name: vehicle_mode_limit_a
vcu_g_0159_20001b3a.description: Mode parameter word written by app_apply_mode_limits as 0x0505 in each mode branch. Meaning not decoded (probably a limit pair of two bytes).

vcu_g_0159_20001b3c.name: vehicle_mode_limit_b
vcu_g_0159_20001b3c.description: Mode parameter word written by app_apply_mode_limits as 0x0505 in each mode branch. Same kind as vehicle_mode_limit_a.

vcu_g_0159_20001b3e.name: vehicle_mode_limit_c
vcu_g_0159_20001b3e.description: Mode parameter word written by app_apply_mode_limits as 0x140F or 0x190F. Probably two bytes: a high byte of 0x14 or 0x19 and a low byte of 0x0F.

vcu_g_0159_20001b40.name: vehicle_mode_limit_d
vcu_g_0159_20001b40.description: Mode parameter word written by app_apply_mode_limits as 0x1919, 0x1414 or 0x2828. Its high byte is read by vcu_serial_parse_variant_code (DAT_20001032 = high byte + 3) and by vcu_wheel_odometer_limit_update.

vcu_g_0159_20001b42.name: vehicle_mode_limit_e
vcu_g_0159_20001b42.description: Mode parameter word written by app_apply_mode_limits as 0x140F or 0x190F, and its high byte is changed by vcu_drive_command_update. Same kind as vehicle_mode_limit_c.

vcu_g_0159_20001b44.name: vehicle_mode_limit_f
vcu_g_0159_20001b44.description: Mode parameter word written by app_apply_mode_limits as 0x1919, 0x1414 or 0x2828. Its high byte is updated by vcu_0159_080054ec and read by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159.

vcu_g_0159_20001b62.name: vehicle_speed_value
vcu_g_0159_20001b62.description: Motion magnitude per tick, probably speed in km/h (the derate and standby code compare it with thresholds 10, 30 and 60). Written by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update and read by most ready, derate and standby routines. Probably updated from the wheel-speed message.

vcu_g_0159_20001b68.name: vehicle_drive_mode_snapshot
vcu_g_0159_20001b68.description: Copy of the drive mode DAT_20001fa4 (values 1 to 4) taken by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update. vcu_drive_command_update branches on it to pick the mode curve.

vcu_g_0159_20001b70.name: vehicle_speed_telemetry_a
vcu_g_0159_20001b70.description: Signed 16-bit speed-derived value, computed by vcu_wheel_odometer_limit_update as ((value << 3) / 10) and copied to telemetry (DAT_200033ac). Probably in units of 0.1 km/h.

vcu_g_0159_20001b72.name: vehicle_speed_telemetry_b
vcu_g_0159_20001b72.description: Signed 16-bit value computed by vcu_wheel_odometer_limit_update and sent in the CAN telemetry payload (can_get_tx_payload_for_id). Units not decoded.

vcu_g_0159_20001b78.name: vehicle_wheel_revolutions
vcu_g_0159_20001b78.description: Wheel revolution counter, incremented by vcu_wheel_odometer_limit_update (saturates at 0xFFFFFFFF). It is zeroed by vcu_0159_080054ec and copied by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker; the stage mark is 5000 revolutions.

vcu_g_0159_20001b7c.name: vehicle_elapsed_time_a
vcu_g_0159_20001b7c.description: Saturating elapsed-time counter advanced once per 100 ticks by vcu_timebase_100_tick (probably seconds). It is cleared by vcu_0159_080054ec.

vcu_g_0159_20001b80.name: vehicle_elapsed_time_b
vcu_g_0159_20001b80.description: Second saturating elapsed-time counter, advanced once per 100 ticks by vcu_timebase_100_tick (probably seconds). It is cleared by vcu_0159_080054ec.

vcu_g_0159_20001b84.name: vehicle_angle_counter
vcu_g_0159_20001b84.description: Angle counter, incremented by vcu_wheel_odometer_limit_update and saturating at 0x7FFF. It is zeroed by vcu_0159_08009da8. vcu_angle_deg_update converts it to degrees using vehicle_angle_period.

vcu_g_0159_20001b86.name: vehicle_elapsed_time_c
vcu_g_0159_20001b86.description: Saturating counter advanced once per 100 ticks by vcu_timebase_100_tick (up to 0x7FFF); zeroed by vcu_0159_08009da8. Units probably the same as vehicle_elapsed_time_a.

vcu_g_0159_20001b88.name: vehicle_angle_period
vcu_g_0159_20001b88.description: Number of angle counts per wheel turn, used as the divisor in vcu_angle_deg_update. It is advanced by vcu_timebase_100_tick (saturating at 0x7FFF) and zeroed by vcu_0159_08009da8; the angle code treats 0 as invalid.

vcu_g_0159_20001b8e.name: vehicle_angle_deg
vcu_g_0159_20001b8e.description: Wheel angle in degrees, 0 to 359, computed by vcu_angle_deg_update as (vehicle_angle_counter * 360) / vehicle_angle_period and set to 0 when the period is not positive. Sent in telemetry by can_get_tx_payload_for_id.

vcu_g_0159_20001b94.name: vehicle_drive_cycle_mode
vcu_g_0159_20001b94.description: Cycle mode 0, 1 or 2 set by vcu_cycle_mode_on_request (from vehicle_cycle_mode_state) and by vcu_runtime_defaults_init (default 1). vcu_drive_command_update packs it into bits 14 and 15 of the drive command word.

vcu_g_0159_20001ba4.name: vehicle_revolution_stage
vcu_g_0159_20001ba4.description: Revolution stage index, 1 to 4, set by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker (3, 4 or 1 in its branches). It drives the stage indicator.

vcu_g_14a_20001c3c.name: vehicle_ready_state_code_v14a
vcu_g_14a_20001c3c.description: Ready-sequence state code of builds 148 and 14a, set to 9, 10 or 13 by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v148_14a. The state codes are probably the values shown on the display.

vcu_g_14a_20001c54.name: vehicle_ready_flag_c_v14a
vcu_g_14a_20001c54.description: Flag of builds 148 and 14a, set to 0 or 1 by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v148_14a. Meaning not decoded.

vcu_g_153_20001c76.name: vehicle_revolution_state_v153
vcu_g_153_20001c76.description: Byte in VCU_153 that vcu_revolution_stage_tracker reads and writes through a pointer. No decompiled line names it; its meaning is not decoded.

vcu_g_0159_20001c88.name: vehicle_revolution_snapshot
vcu_g_0159_20001c88.description: Copy of the low 16 bits of vehicle_wheel_revolutions, taken by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker. Zeroed by vcu_runtime_defaults_init. It is read back as vehicle_revolution_stage_ref.

vcu_g_0159_20001cd2.name: vehicle_drive_scaled_value
vcu_g_0159_20001cd2.description: Signed 16-bit value computed by vcu_wheel_odometer_limit_update as (value * DAT_20001e62) / 100. It is probably the scaled drive-limit input for the output limit.

vcu_g_0159_20001cf6.name: vehicle_standby_latch
vcu_g_0159_20001cf6.description: Standby latch set to 1 by vcu_standby_entry_timer after 600 quiet ticks. vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval and vcu_standby_entry_timer test it, and vcu_0159_08009da8 clears it.

vcu_g_0159_20001cf8.name: vehicle_mode_gate_state
vcu_g_0159_20001cf8.description: Mode gate state 0 or 1 (values below 2), tested by vcu_special_mode_gate and vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. It is set by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update and cleared by vcu_0159_08009da8.

vcu_g_0159_20001cfc.name: vehicle_ready_state_code
vcu_g_0159_20001cfc.description: Ready-sequence state code of builds 14b to 0159, set to 9, 10 or 13 by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. Passed to the display renderer (FUN_0800c31c) by vcu_display_frame_render_tick.

vcu_g_0159_20001d14.name: vehicle_ready_flag_d
vcu_g_0159_20001d14.description: Flag of builds 14b to 0159 set to 0 or 1 by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. vcu_display_frame_render_tick copies it into bit 1 of the display status word.

vcu_g_0159_20001d38.name: vehicle_display_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001d38.description: Flag set to 0 or 1 by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker and vcu_0159_080054ec. vcu_display_frame_render_tick tests it when it builds the display frame.

vcu_g_0159_20001e66.name: vehicle_rx_value_b
vcu_g_0159_20001e66.description: 16-bit value copied from a received message (payload offset 0x0B) by vcu_rx_frame_dispatch. It is compared against 30 after division by 100, so it is probably in hundredths of a unit (for example a voltage or current).

vcu_g_0159_20001e6a.name: vehicle_rx_status_flags
vcu_g_0159_20001e6a.description: Status flags byte written by vcu_rx_frame_dispatch from a received message. Bit 3 is tested by the debounce, derate and standby routines.

vcu_g_0159_20001f4c.name: vehicle_sensor_clamped
vcu_g_0159_20001f4c.description: Sensor value clamped by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval (undefined1 cast of a 16-bit result). Compared with 51 (0x33) and 50 (0x32) by vcu_drive_command_update; probably a percentage or a temperature.

vcu_g_0159_20001f50.name: vehicle_status_bit_f50
vcu_g_0159_20001f50.description: Status flag set to 0 or 1 by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval. It is a readiness condition of vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159 and of vcu_special_mode_gate.

vcu_g_0159_20001f62.name: vehicle_derate_flag_a
vcu_g_0159_20001f62.description: Derate flag set or cleared by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval. vcu_fault_warning_evaluate sets a warning when this flag or vehicle_derate_flag_e is 1.

vcu_g_0159_20001f63.name: vehicle_derate_flag_b
vcu_g_0159_20001f63.description: Derate flag set or cleared by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval. vcu_special_mode_gate tests it, and vcu_fault_warning_evaluate tests it together with vehicle_derate_flag_d.

vcu_g_0159_20001f64.name: vehicle_derate_flag_c
vcu_g_0159_20001f64.description: Derate flag set or cleared by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval. vcu_special_mode_gate and vcu_fault_warning_evaluate test it.

vcu_g_0159_20001f66.name: vehicle_derate_flag_d
vcu_g_0159_20001f66.description: Derate flag set or cleared by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval. vcu_special_mode_gate and vcu_fault_warning_evaluate test it.

vcu_g_0159_20001f67.name: vehicle_derate_flag_e
vcu_g_0159_20001f67.description: Derate flag set to 1 when 0x19 is less than the sensor value minus 30, and cleared otherwise by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval. vcu_fault_warning_evaluate tests it with vehicle_derate_flag_a.

vcu_g_0159_20001f6a.name: vehicle_derate_flag_f
vcu_g_0159_20001f6a.description: Derate flag set or cleared by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval. vcu_special_mode_gate and vcu_fault_warning_evaluate test it.

vcu_g_0159_20001f6f.name: vehicle_sensor_burst_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001f6f.description: Flag set by vcu_sensor_threshold_pulse_count when the sustained-high condition holds. It is cleared after the burst message is sent (when DAT_2000101a is 0).

vcu_g_0159_20001f72.name: vehicle_toggle_request
vcu_g_0159_20001f72.description: Request flag set to 1 by a key edge in vcu_input_edge_actions and cleared by vcu_toggle_special_mode after it toggles the mode byte.

vcu_g_0159_20001f75.name: vehicle_cycle_request
vcu_g_0159_20001f75.description: Request flag set to 1 by an input edge in vcu_input_edge_actions. vcu_cycle_mode_on_request handles it and clears it.

vcu_g_0159_20001f78.name: vehicle_status_flags_f78
vcu_g_0159_20001f78.description: Input and status flags byte. Bit 0 gates the debounce and standby routines, bit 2 is tested by vcu_drive_command_update, and bit 3 is tested by the debounce and derate routines. Written by vcu_rx_frame_dispatch.

vcu_g_0159_20001f8c.name: vehicle_state_word_f8c
vcu_g_0159_20001f8c.description: Packed state word whose address is taken by about ten functions, including vcu_state_params_reset. Its fields are not decoded in this packet; the 16-bit words that follow it are described separately.

vcu_g_0159_20001f90.name: vehicle_derate_word
vcu_g_0159_20001f90.description: Derate word. vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval sets its low byte to a scaled value (sensor minus 55, times 200 divided by 125) or 0; its low byte is compared with 180 (0xB4) by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. Read by the input-B hold sequence.

vcu_g_0159_20001f92.name: vehicle_request_flags
vcu_g_0159_20001f92.description: Request and status word with several bits. Bit 2 is the standby request set by vcu_standby_entry_timer, bit 7 is set and cleared by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159, and bits 2 and 3 are written by vcu_special_mode_gate. It is cleared in its low 12 bits by vcu_status_flags_mask_low.

vcu_g_0159_20001f94.name: vehicle_drive_command_word
vcu_g_0159_20001f94.description: Packed drive command word. Its low byte is loaded from the derate and ramp values by vcu_drive_command_update and reset by vcu_state_params_reset. Bits 14 and 15 hold vehicle_drive_cycle_mode, and vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update and can_get_tx_payload_for_id read it.

vcu_g_0159_20001f96.name: vehicle_drive_output_word
vcu_g_0159_20001f96.description: Packed output word. vcu_state_params_reset loads it with 0x2800 or 0x3200 (the default mode limit), and vcu_drive_command_update rewrites its low byte with a ramp value. The low byte is copied to telemetry by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update.

vcu_g_0159_20001f98.name: vehicle_status_word_f98
vcu_g_0159_20001f98.description: Status word holding the PA6 and mode code in bits 9 to 11 (rewritten by vcu_pa6_output_status_update), bit 12 (set by vcu_0159_080047ac) and the pulse-sequence bits 0 to 1 (vcu_c14_c15_pulse_sequencer). Cleared in bits 9 to 11 by vcu_clear_flag_bits_9_11.

vcu_g_0159_20001fac.name: vehicle_countdown_a
vcu_g_0159_20001fac.description: Countdown in ticks. It is reloaded by vcu_event_countdown_a (from its parameter), set to 3000 by vcu_code_nibble_entry_tick, and set to 0 by vcu_0159_080047ac. It fires at 1 and then sets the flag DAT_20001fb4.

vcu_g_0159_20001fbd.name: vehicle_revolution_flag_a
vcu_g_0159_20001fbd.description: Flag of the revolution stage tracker (VCU_0159 only). vcu_revolution_stage_tracker sets it when the stage index is non-zero and clears it; vcu_0159_080047ac clears it too.

vcu_g_0159_20001fbe.name: vehicle_revolution_flag_b
vcu_g_0159_20001fbe.description: Flag of the revolution stage tracker (VCU_0159 only). vcu_0159_080054ec and vcu_runtime_defaults_init set it to 1, and vcu_revolution_stage_tracker clears it.

vcu_g_0159_20001fc0.name: vehicle_pa11_pulse_armed
vcu_g_0159_20001fc0.description: Armed flag of the PA11 pulse. vcu_periodic_100_tick_check, vcu_0159_080047ac and vcu_0159_080054ec set it to 1, and vcu_pa11_pulse_step runs the 5-tick high and 1-tick low pulse while it is set.

vcu_g_0159_20001fd2.name: vehicle_countdown_b
vcu_g_0159_20001fd2.description: Countdown in ticks, reloaded to 1000 by vcu_0159_080047ac and decremented by vcu_event_countdown_b. It fires at 0 and sets the flag DAT_20001fd4.

vcu_g_0159_20001fd6.name: vehicle_special_mode_stage
vcu_g_0159_20001fd6.description: Special mode stage, 0 or 1. vcu_special_mode_gate sets it to 1 when the gate conditions hold for 300 ticks and tests it when leaving; vcu_0159_080047ac clears it.

vcu_g_0159_20001fd9.name: vehicle_standby_request_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001fd9.description: Request flag set to 1 by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval and to 0 by vcu_ready_sequence_step_v14b_0159. vcu_standby_entry_timer tests it and clears it.

vcu_g_153_200020a8.name: vehicle_revolution_stage_words_v153
vcu_g_153_200020a8.description: Two 32-bit words in VCU_153 (0x200020A8 and 0x200020AC) written by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker through a pointer. No decompiled line names them; the words are probably stage or mark values.
